title: 1980s shift from secrecy to flooding the zone
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 1980s shift from secrecy to flooding the zone, about 1980s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: felt like largely maybe the US moved from a strategy of um you know secrecy and denial to flood the zone.

plain: Talking with a UFO historian, the podcast host Jesse Michels suggests that in the 1980s the US government changed how it dealt with UFOs. He says it moved away from simply keeping secrets and denying everything, and started to "flood the zone": filling public discussion with so much mixed information that the truth would be hard to pick out.
